 By KOB

 Joey Ortiz First Aggie to Play in World Series
 MILWAUKEE — If you’ve been keeping up with the World Series, you might not realize there is a former New Mexico State Aggies on the Milwaukee Brewers.
 Third baseman Joey Ortiz is the first Aggie to play in a World Series. Ortiz was with the Aggies from 2017-2019.
 So far this season, Ortiz has nine home runs and 47 RBI’s while hitting with a .270 batting average.
 Now, the Brewers currently hold a 3-0 series lead over the Tampa Bay Rays. Game four is at 6 p.m., Tuesday night, when the Brewers could secure the World Series.
